_comment: Approximate US retail (MSRP, pre-tax) used as the Index baseline (MSRP = 100). TCGCSV publishes NO MSRP field, so these are curated, not sourced -- treat the MSRP index as an approximation and edit freely. Resolution order: byProduct (productId) > bySet ('groupId:productType') > byType (game -> productType). Anything unresolved falls back to the release-day index. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

Magic._comment: Play/Draft ~ $4/pack x 36; Set ~ $5/pack x 30; Collector ~ $25/pack x 12. Varies by set -- override in bySet where it matters.

bySet._comment: Per-set override, keyed 'groupId:productType'. Use for sets whose MSRP clearly differs from the type default (premium/licensed sets, Special Editions).

byProduct._comment: Per-item override, keyed productId. Highest precedence.
